text_block_list.text:
One day, I visited Yukoma Ryokan to hang 
out... and found the landlady narrowing 
her eyes with a fond gaze at items she had 
taken out of a box.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. Just a little keepsake, 
you could say.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to be cleaning, but my 
hands completely ground to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Wanna stick around and watch?

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Ah, this is... a photo from opening day.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
She is the proprietress of a long-standing 
inn who taught me the art of hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Even with her busy schedule, she took 
great care of me. And to think so many 
people from the hot spring town gathered 
here……

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is our very first guestbook, see. Our 
first customer left it behind for us.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It was my first time, so my customer 
service was far from perfect. There was 
plenty of room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Taking all that into account, they 
still left a message of encouragement. 
What a kind person.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is the shop curtain Yunohana made 
when she first came to work with us. She's 
real good at writing these cute, rounded 
characters.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The proud look on your face when you held 
up that noren curtain and spread it right 
in front of me…… Hehe, I still remember it 
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...You've really been carried through life 
by the kindness and goodwill of so many 
people, haven't you?
choice_data_list:
It's all because you worked so hard, 
Proprietress.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I was just so green it was painful 
to watch.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Crude or clumsy as it might be―― I 
weathered a whole storm of firsts... and 
somehow made it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ――Hey there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of keepsakes and 
memories you'll end up collecting over 
time?

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
You're still young. You've got a whole 
world of experiences ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The fun moments, the joyful moments—all of 
it—

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
And there are also bitter moments, the 
kind that seem to wipe all of that away in 
a heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
All those unforgettable memories will pile 
up, shaping who you become.
choice_data_list: ...True. Life has its twists and turns.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a great many things. And that is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you save a little corner of 
those memories for me, okay?
I accept what the landlady offers me.

Opening the hand revealed... a single 
mahjong tile.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Bring that back here and we'll finally 
have a full set of tiles to play with.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Listen, alright? If you stay stiff as a 
board, nothing's gonna work out right!

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Come by to blow off some steam whenever! 
I'll spar with ya as many times as it 
takes until you can beat me!

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
So—whenever you feel like looking down, 
remember this.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
To show them that adults like this existed 
too!

—My steps leaving the inn were lighter 
than usual.

Gripping the mahjong tile in hand, over 
and over again.
choice_data_list: ...I ended up getting a good luck charm.

text_block_list.text:
Someone who has tasted both the sweet and 
the bitter. Someone who looks forward to 
your growth with all their heart.

Seeing how reliable she was reassured 
me... and left me feeling ready to give it 
my all again tomorrow.
